meta.title: TVTracker — Every show. Every film. Never lose track.
meta.description: Track every show and film you watch, see where to stream it, and know the moment your show comes back. Free on iPhone, Android and the web, in English and Arabic.

hero.lede: Tick off episodes, see where to stream, and know the moment your show comes back.

why.title: Made for how you actually watch.

upNext.title: Never lose your place
upNext.text: Your next episode is always on top. One tap and it's ticked off.

moods.title: Can't decide? Pick a mood.
moods.text: Tell us how tonight feels — we start from your watchlist.

import.title: Bring your history
import.text: From TV Time, Trakt, IMDb or Bingers — in about a minute.

footer.attribution: Film and TV data and images from TMDB. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. Where-to-watch data by JustWatch. TVTracker is not affiliated with TV Time. © 2026 Alphabet.

about.lede: One place for the films and shows you have finished, the ones you are halfway through, and the ones you keep meaning to start.
about.built: Built for people who finish things.

screens.title: Every screen
screens.text: One library on the web, iPhone, iPad and Android. Same place, instantly.

free.title: Free to use
free.text: Works in the browser, no install needed. No ads in your way.

languages.title: English & العربية
languages.text: The whole app, in both languages.

data.title: Data you can trust
data.text: Film and show data and artwork by TMDB and TheTVDB. Where-to-watch data by JustWatch.

switching.title: TV Time closed. Your history doesn't have to.
switching.text: Bring every show, episode and film you've logged — from TV Time, IMDb, Letterboxd, Trakt or any CSV. It takes about a minute.

phone.from: From TV Time, IMDb, Letterboxd and Trakt
